title: The Mirror
wikitext:
The '''Mirror''' is a concept and technology associated with [[Yi Sang]] and later used by Limbus Company.

== Origins ==
Work on the Mirror is tied to the [[League of Nine]] and to Yi Sang. [[Dongrang]] is among those connected to this research history.

== Role ==
The Mirror is used in connection with Identities and alternate possibilities. Story context for Yi Sang's relation to it is expanded in [[Canto IV]].
